title: Change app theme to white color

requirements.text: Replace the current saturated yellow theme with a clean white theme across the entire application. Update the CSS color tokens in frontend/src/index.css and frontend/index.css so that backgrounds use white/near-white tones (OKLCH with high lightness, zero or near-zero chroma), foreground/text remains dark (near-black), and accent/interactive colors shift to neutral grays or a subtle off-white palette. Ensure no yellow background colors remain on cards, headers, hero sections, buttons, or any UI element.
acceptanceCriteria: All page backgrounds render as white or near-white (no yellow tones visible)
The sticky header background is white
Property cards have a white or light gray background
Hero section background is white or very light
Buttons and interactive elements use neutral/gray or subtle accent colors — no yellow
Text remains readable with sufficient contrast on white backgrounds
Both light and dark mode CSS tokens are updated consistently
The footer background matches the white theme
Agent dashboard and form pages also use the white theme

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Do not alter backend logic or data models
nonGoals: Adding new features or UI components
Changing layout structure or typography scale
